title: BluPetal to Release Animate International BL Titles Exclusively
content: English manga publisher BluPetal announced at its panel at Anime Expo on Friday that it now has an agreement with Animate International to be the sole agent and subdistributor for English-language editions of titles published by Animate International in worldwide English-language markets, effective October 2026.
author: ANN

title: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi Anime's Trailer Unveils August 5 Debut
content: The "First Look | Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi " panel at Anime Expo presented a new trailer for Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi , the limited anime series spinoff from the Star Wars: Visions project , on Thursday. The trailer announces the series' August 5 premiere on Disney+ and Hulu .
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll to Screen Akira Anime Film in U.S., Canada in 4K, IMAX on September 4
content: Crunchyroll announced on Thursday it and Sony Pictures Entertainment will release Katsuhiro Ōtomo 's Akira anime film in select theaters in the United States and Canada in 4K and IMAX on September 4. The release will be available both in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub.
author: ANN

title: ALIEN STAGE Anime Series Announced
content: The hit multimedia project ALIEN STAGE is officially getting an anime series adaptation. The announcement was made at the franchise’s panel at Anime Expo 2026. The announcement was made through the franchise’s official social media channels, confirming that an ALIEN STAGE anime series is now in production.
author: Anime Corner

title: 30 Years Later, Classic Shojo Series Finally Confirms Release Fans Have Been Waiting For
content: Boys Over Flowers received the Shogakukan Manga Award in 1996 and eventually became one of the best-selling manga series of all time, as well as the best-selling shōjo manga of all time, with over 61 million copies sold worldwide.
author: ComicBook

title: To You in the Beyond Anime Film Casts Naohito Fujiki
content: The official website for To You in the Beyond , the anime film of Akiko Abe 's Doko Yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e novel, revealed on Friday that Naohito Fujiki joins the film's cast as Nishina, Kazuki Tsukigase's homeroom teacher who watches over him.
author: ANN

title: 7 Years Ago, Attack on Titan Changed Forever With the End of an Era
content: Based on the acclaimed manga by Hajime Isayama, the anime adaptation of Attack on Titan reached unprecedented heights of popularity ever since its debut in 2013. The series was initially adapted by WIT Studio and released the first three seasons of the anime.
author: ComicBook

title: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi New Anime Series by Production I.G Releases First Trailer Ahead of August 5 Premiere
content: Lucasfilm has released the first full trailer for Star Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi , giving a new look at the upcoming anime series ahead of its August 5, 2026 premiere on Disney+ and Hulu.
author: Anime Corner

title: Beloved Shonen Jump Series’ Revival Film Confirms Disappointing Streaming Update
content: The most banned manga franchise in the United States is coming back for a new feature film ten years after its anime adaptation came to an end, and a new trailer is showing it off in action.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix Shares Major Jujutsu Kaisen Update Ahead of Season 4
content: 2026 kicked off with the exciting Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Part 1, which features the aftermath of the Shibuya Incident Arc before commencing the Culling Game. Following the flashback arc in Season 2, which features Satoru Gojo, the anime follows the brutal battle in Shibuya.
author: ComicBook
